I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/upx`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
PackLinuxElf32::un_asl_dynsym in p_lx_elf.cpp can dereference an invalid/null dynamic-string pointer while processing ELF dynamic symbols. The bug leads to adjABS calling strcmp on an invalid dynstr-derived pointer, producing an invalid read/segmentation fault when unpacking specially crafted ELF inputs. This results in a crash (denial-of-service) when handling malformed/partial ELF files.
